text:
maria: quick proposal - default new API keys to project-scoped, show "effective_project" in console, require explicit checkbox for org-wide keys to avoid accidental cross-project billing spikes.

sam: makes sense. how do we treat legacy org keys?

maria: legacy keys unchanged. routing precedence: key.project -> project, else org-scoped, else reject if account strict.

irene: telemetry: add `effective_project` and `declared_scope` to access logs and a metric `auth.effective_project_breakdown` so we can compute billing deltas.

sam: quotas: keep org keys on org bucket short-term; show simulated per-project impact in console. later add auto-split using `X-Redwood-Project-Hint`.

maria: rollout: FF for new-key default + small canary opt-ins, enable audit logs and alert for quota drops.

irene: UI mock: key row pill `proj:<id>` or `org` + "simulate switch" that backtests 30d usage. will upload mock.

sam: add prometheus alert for sudden shifts in `auth.effective_project` distribution per org.

noah-bot: ticket AUTH-4601 created: "default project keys + telemetry" assigned maria, sam, irene.

maria: action items: @sam RFC for routing/quota semantics, @irene telemetry schema & mocks, i'll draft migration UX. target: RFC + mocks in 7 days.
